hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro fled Brazil for Florida via Argentina following his electoral defeat to Lula da Silva, proclaiming himself the legitimate president and alleging widespread voter fraud without evidence. His escape has triggered an international diplomatic row involving Brazil, Argentina, and the US, alongside Senate efforts to strip his mandate and salary.
hotspots.affect: Commands white-hot attention through the unprecedented spectacle of a fugitive presidential candidate claiming presidency from abroad while stoking voter fraud outrage.

hotspots.title: Polish Constitutional Court Crisis & Coup Accusations
hotspots.blurb: Poland's political standoff exploded after President Karol Nawrocki cut short an official visit to Senegal and forced his way into the Constitutional Tribunal building at night alongside PiS leaders. Opposition figures accused Prime Minister Donald Tusk of a 'coup d'état' following the suspension of top judges, sparking street protests and physical clashes outside the court.
hotspots.affect: Reaches maximum intensity as top constitutional bodies physically clash in Warsaw under explicit accusations of a state coup and democratic collapse.

hotspots.title: SD Internal Feud Over Swedish Identity Principles
hotspots.blurb: Sweden Democrats leader Jimmie Åkesson has taken an uncompromising stance against internal party rivals in a escalating fight over 'open Swedishness' versus ethnic nationalism. Åkesson threatened to expel members like Richard Jomshof who view ethnicity as essential to national identity, while party-aligned media outlet Riks faces severe funding cuts.
hotspots.affect: Generates high affective charge as Sweden's dominant right-wing force turns inward with public ultimatum threats over its identity core.

hotspots.title: Nigel Farage MP Altercation Row & Reform Campaign
hotspots.blurb: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage faces intense media scrutiny after Lib Dem MP Caroline Voaden accused him of physically shoving her in the House of Commons. The incident coincides with widespread condemnation over racial slurs directed at Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch by a Farage ally and news that a Reform campaign security guard was jailed for rape.
hotspots.affect: Sustains high emotional investment driven by parliamentary physical misconduct claims, racial slurs, and high-visibility campaign scandals.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: The Rassemblement National is embroiled in heavy controversy following its recent party congress and campaign launch. Local politicians and lawyers have linked party rhetoric to a fatal racist attack in Trappes, while the party simultaneously grapples with a massive 150,000-member data breach, press freedom boycotts, and legal notices over campaign materials.
hotspots.affect: Commands ongoing focus through the volatile mix of presidential campaign posturing, severe legal scrutiny, and accusations of inciting hate violence.
